lines.en: label wakanaspringmorninggen:
scene wakanaspringmorninggen
I call up Wakana shortly after waking up to find that she has nothing going on today. And I'm surprised to hear her invite me over just a few seconds later.
lines.zh: 醒来不久我给 Wakana 打电话，发现她今天没事。而几秒钟后就听到她邀请我过去，我挺意外。

lines.en: Unsure of whether or not I'll have to keep this visit a secret from her girlfriend, I make my way over to her apartment and find her still dressed in her pajamas once I get there.
lines.zh: 不确定这次拜访是不是得对她女朋友保密，我还是去了她的公寓，到了才发现她还穿着睡衣。

lines.en: I don't know when she decided to start letting her guard down around me, and I can't figure out if it's a good thing or a bad thing.
lines.zh: 我不知道她什么时候开始在我面前放下戒备，也想不出这是好事还是坏事。

lines.en: I know she still sees me as a {i}threat.{/i} She reminds me all the time. And it feels like just the other day that I was cornering her in the library.
lines.zh: 我知道她依然把我当成{i}威胁{/i}。她一直提醒我。而我把她逼在图书馆角落那件事，感觉就像前几天才发生。

lines.en: All that's changed since then is how openly miserable I am, so maybe {i}that's{/i} what pushed her over the edge and gave the go-ahead to stop giving a shit when I'm around.
lines.zh: 从那以后唯一变了的，是我有多么公开地痛苦，所以也许正是{i}这个{/i}把她推过了那条线，让她在我面前决定不再在乎。

lines.en: She probably thinks I'm too weak to pounce. That I'm a malnourished coyote and she's a well-fed and elusive rabbit.
lines.zh: 她大概觉得我太弱，扑不动了。觉得我是一只营养不良的土狼，而她是只吃得饱饱的、行踪难觅的兔子。

lines.en: I could probably catch her if I truly want to.
lines.zh: 我要是真想，大概抓得住她。

lines.en: I just don't know if it's worth the effort.
lines.zh: 我只是不知道值不值得费那个劲。

lines.en: scene black
We wind up ordering breakfast from some local restaurant and I'm not surprised to find that Kaori is the delivery girl.
lines.zh: 我们最后从本地一家餐厅点了早餐，而送餐的是 Kaori 时我一点都不意外。

lines.en: I am surprised to find Wakana address her by name once she arrives, though. But I guess that makes sense considering the two of them are neighbors.
lines.zh: 我意外的是 Kaori 到了之后 Wakana 直接叫了她的名字。不过想想她俩是邻居，也就说得通了。

lines.en: We spend the morning coexisting. Wakana tells me stories of what's happening in school and I feign interest while I attempt to forget school altogether.
lines.zh: 我们整个上午就这么共处。Wakana 跟我讲学校里发生的事，我装出感兴趣的样子，同时努力把「学校」这回事整个忘掉。

lines.en: She asks me when I'll be coming back. {i}If{/i} I'll be coming back. And I don't have an answer for her.
lines.zh: 她问我什么时候回来。{i}会不会{/i}回来。而我给不出答案。

lines.en: She smiles in a way that only {i}she{/i} can smile and tells me to take my time, but I know she wants me to hurry.
lines.zh: 她用只有{i}她{/i}会的方式笑了笑，叫我慢慢来，可我知道她希望我快点。

lines.en: She misses me.
She just won't say it out loud.
